name: html_signup_form_accessibility
prompt:
Fix the HTML signup form accessibility and validation bug.

Requirements:
- Modify index.html only.
- The email input must have type="email".
- The email input must be required.
- The password input must have type="password".
- The password input must be required.
- Each input must have a matching label using for/id.
- The submit button must have type="submit".
- Do not modify validate.py.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only the form block changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: python validate.py
